name: automatic-entity-measurements
goal: Show automatically collected source metrics and recorded performance without confusing missing evidence with test failures

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: At de0774e the helper page has no attached record, source metrics or benchmark. Expected: commit-derived static metrics, recorded benchmark observations without budgets, and distinct missing/failure indicators.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: History indexing tested records but not unverified source metrics. Measurement UI only tested budgeted workloads. Verdict tests required red for every unknown state. Strengthen these standard suites and loop recording capture retention.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: The committed standard coverage failed on missing source metrics, discarded benchmark captures, budget-only display and red missing-evidence icons. Record 34b7c053 proves the frozen corpus at 68bb50cc.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Read source metrics from exact Git trees; preserve benchmark observations in focused proofs; show observations without a budget and only the selected callable; distinguish missing coverage from failed checks.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged frozen standard tests passed at b5dd8821, including source metrics without records, benchmark retention, budget-free display and responsive checkpoints. Eight real casing-helper benchmark measurements were retained in Git-backed focused proof.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
